title: 43:2 passest through the waters/rivers . . . not overflow thee. Isaiah recalls the exodus of ancient Israel from Egypt by mentioning her miraculous passage through the Red Sea (Ex. 14:21-22) and the Jordan River (Josh. 3:13-17). The gathering of modern Israel calls to mind the exodus from Egypt, and modern Israel will likewise be safely guided through the hardships and dangers of the world.
author: Tina M. Peterson
